xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4201: Command Deck issue tree: real state badge instead of 'Allocated', de-duplicate resource chips, clearer hierarchy and colors

plan.title: Command Deck issue tree: real state badge instead of 'Allocated', de-duplicate resource chips, clearer hierarchy and colors
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The Command Deck issue tree shows an 'Allocated' pill on every row (the server stateLabel fallback for any issue with a workspace or branch), repeats resource facts as text chips under every row and again in the expanded Resources group, has an unexplained five-segment progress strip, a mis-aligned caret, a lavender selected block with no nesting hierarchy, wrapped two-line titles, and state pills that break the style guide (pill radius, hardcoded hex).
narratives.Proposal: Render a state badge from the derived issue state through a new pure resolver (resolveFeatureStateBadge) with style-guide tones on existing tokens; add a StatusDot for live agents and keep one colored signal per row; label the pipeline pips with the current step; collapse resources into one icon-only ResourceCluster and make the expanded ResourcesGroup containers-only (deleting BranchNode/PrNode); align the caret, make ID+title one truncated line, and neutralize selection with visible child nesting. Verify with a mocked Playwright spec that commits light/dark screenshots, and document the row anatomy in docs/ISSUE-VIEW.md. Full detail: .pan/drafts/pan-4201.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing the server deriveStateLabel or removing stateLabel from /api/issues/resource-allocated
- Changing other stateLabel readers in FeatureItem.tsx (defaultExpandedFromState, isOrphanedFeature, derivePipeline done check, Rally StatusIcon)
- Redesigning the palette or adding new color tokens (PAN-4197 owns the palette)
- Changing AgentStepRow, the cockpit, kanban, pipeline page or other surfaces' state vocabulary, or the base .sessionNode rule
- Adding container actions to the tree ResourcesGroup
- Changing ProjectNode headers, CI/deploy chips or the conversation list
- Removing any issue-view inventory section (Pipeline pips, ResourceStrip, ResourcesGroup stay)

autoDecisions.summary: State badge source precedence: store derived state, then REST feature.state, then pipeline-bucket/tracker fallback, then no badge; never stateLabel.
autoDecisions.rationale: Both sources are the same FR-6 derivation; the store is live and already drives isReady, so one resolved value feeds the badge and the Merge button and they cannot disagree. REST state is null for rows without live resources, so a fallback is needed to avoid blank badges on merged/closed rows.

autoDecisions.summary: Tones follow the style guide literally: In review, Changes requested and Ready amber; Working blue; Planning purple; Merged emerald; Backlog, Parked, Planned and Closed neutral. No new tokens.
autoDecisions.rationale: The style guide assigns amber to the In Review phase and human gates, blue to machine work, purple to specialist verbs including planning, emerald to outcomes. Existing tokens cover every tone, so PAN-4197 can retune them in one place without a forked palette.

autoDecisions.summary: Pipeline pips are labelled (step n of 5, named current step, per-segment titles), not removed.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue allows either; labelling keeps a no-loss inventory section and at-a-glance progress with the smallest diff.

autoDecisions.summary: Resources appear once as an icon-only cluster on the meta line in both states; the expanded ResourcesGroup lists containers only; BranchNode and PrNode are deleted.
autoDecisions.rationale: The cluster already hosts the xBRIEF/tasks/PRD viewer clicks and orphan cleanup, so keeping it as the single home is lower risk than relocating those affordances; the group keeps only live container stats the cluster lacks.

autoDecisions.summary: Feature titles become one line with an ellipsis and a full-title tooltip, superseding the v1.2 two-line clamp.
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator's 2026-09-25 request is the newer authority and asks for exactly this.

autoDecisions.summary: One colored status signal per row: the state badge. A StatusDot marks live agents; the edge bar keeps only red error; running aggregate badges go neutral; '! INPUT' and '✕ review' keep color.
autoDecisions.rationale: Style-guide color restraint allows one colored signal plus actionable exceptions; the removed edge variants repeated the badge color.

autoDecisions.summary: OKF command-deck concept is updated in the sibling eltmon/overdeck-knowledge repo after merge; in-repo docs go in docs/ISSUE-VIEW.md.
autoDecisions.rationale: The OKF bundle is a separate repository and cannot ship in this PR.

items.title: Add the pure resolveFeatureStateBadge resolver and the ProjectFeature.state field

narrative.Action: PRD .pan/drafts/pan-4201.md §5.1 and WI-1. Create featureStateBadge.ts exporting FeatureStateTone, FeatureStateBadge, FeatureStateBadgeInput and resolveFeatureStateBadge(input) with the exact nine-state label/tone/title table, the planning override (planned|backlog|null + a planning session with presence active|idle => 'Planning'/specialist), the null fallbacks (post_merge_limbo => 'Merged'/outcome; rawTrackerState containing closed|done|canceled => 'Closed'/rest) and null otherwise. Precedence: storeState ?? restState. Add `state?: IssueState | null` to ProjectFeature in ProjectNode.tsx with the doc comment from the PRD. Write featureStateBadge.test.ts with the seven test groups listed in WI-1.

items.title: Given each of the nine IssueState values as restState, when resolveFeatureStateBadge runs, then it returns the label and tone from PRD §5.1 (e.g. 'changes-requested' returns 'Changes requested' with tone 'human')

Given a null state with pipelineBucket 'post_merge_limbo' it returns 'Merged'; with rawTrackerState 'Done' it returns 'Closed'; with no bucket, tracker state or sessions it returns null
